subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal/admin WhatsApp contact inventory, and what fields, redaction, account-scope, and authorization rules should it expose?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but exposing sender IDs, permission state, and activity data crosses product and security policy boundaries that source inspection cannot safely choose.

options.title: Design scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a narrow CLI/admin inventory that merges approved senders and configured allowlists, with explicit privacy redaction and account-scoped authorization rules.

options.title: Start with #56621 only
options.body: Implement list-approved and revoke first, then revisit group policy and last-active fields after the narrower pairing-management surface lands.

options.title: Defer terminal inventory
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and require future design work to happen in Control UI or a broader admin console instead.

recommendation.title: Design scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a narrow CLI/admin inventory that merges approved senders and configured allowlists, with explicit privacy redaction and account-scoped authorization rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest merged history for the central pairing, allowlist, store, and WhatsApp directory files points to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product/security decision.
